column1: # The game's item id of each ground item in spawns.tsv, for its picture on the map (SpawnMarks). Made from
# the game cache (rev 2746) by the notes' research/gen/ItemIds.java: the item of that name with the
# Wiki's "(...)" dropped, the lowest id that is not a noted or placeholder copy; else the name without a
# plural "s", else its lowest dose. Edit a row to pick another picture; an item missing here is drawn as a dot.
